POV: “I’ll eat healthy tomorrow” starts right after this bite 😭  Creamy Cheesy Buldak Noodles 🌶️🧀 Ingredients 2 slices American cheese 1 slice baby Swiss cheese 2 tbsp ketchup 2 tbsp Kewpie mayo 1 tbsp chili oil (plus more for topping) 1 packet Buldak sauce and seasoning powder 2–3 tbsp chopped green onions (plus more for garnish) ½ cup heavy cream 1 packet Buldak noodles, boiled until half cooked Cooked dumplings, for topping Cooked sausage, sliced, for topping Instructions In a pan over low heat, add the American cheese and baby Swiss cheese. Add the ketchup, Kewpie mayo, chili oil, Buldak sauce, seasoning powder, and chopped green onions. Stir until the cheese melts and everything is well combined. Pour in the heavy cream and mix until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Add the half-cooked Buldak noodles and toss until every strand is coated in the rich, cheesy sauce. Top with cooked dumplings and sliced sausage. Finish with an extra drizzle of chili oil and more chopped green onions. Serve hot and enjoy! #r#ramenb#buldakr#Recipec#cookspicy

Testing VIRAL watermelon ice cream! (it's messy) ✨Recipe: Ingredients: • 1 personal-sized watermelon • ½ cup Heavy cream Directions: 1. Slice the watermelon in half and scoop out flesh from the center, leaving a thick layer attached to the rind to create a natural bowl. 2. Place the watermelon halves in the freezer overnight, or until completely frozen. 3. Pour about ½ cup of heavy cream into the center of one frozen watermelon half. Using a sturdy spoon, continuously scrape the frozen fruit while churning the cream until it transforms into a smooth, soft ice cream-like texture. 4. Scoop into bowls or enjoy it straight from the watermelon for a refreshing homemade frozen treat! 🍉

Creamy Cheesy Buldak Ramen 🍜🧀🔥 Ingredients 1 pack Buldak ramen 1 slice baby Swiss cheese 1 slice American cheese 1 slice Monterey Jack cheese 2 tbsp mayo Buldak sauce packet Buldak powder packet Chili oil 2 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp chopped green onions ½ cup heavy cream or milk Cooked ramen noodles Toppings Fried egg Mini sausages Dumplings Extra green onions Extra chili oil Instructions Cook the Buldak noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside. In a pan over low heat, add the baby Swiss, American, and Monterey Jack cheese slices. Add the mayo, Buldak sauce, Buldak powder, chili oil, minced garlic, and green onions on top of the cheese. Mix everything together until the cheese melts into a thick spicy paste. Pour in the heavy cream or milk and stir until smooth and creamy. Add the cooked noodles and toss until fully coated in the sauce. Top with fried egg, dumplings, mini sausages, extra green onions, and more chili oil if desired. Enjoy hot and creamy  #buldak #buldakramen #eat #food  #Foodie
